original_test_intent: Validate OAM_3 sensor completeness, health and cross-interface consistency among SMC, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.
original_method: Establish OAM_3's physical-to-Redfish-to-IPMI-to-ROCm device mapping, collect synchronized read-only samples, normalize units/status and compare every expected sensor within approved tolerances.
manual_activity: GPU/BMC owner approves the OAM_3 physical and ROCm index mapping plus sensor acceptance and decides findings.
required_inputs: Expected sensor population and status rules
safety_requirements: Derive ROCm device mapping from approved stable identity, not enumeration order
Abort on wrong module, stale data, missing units or unknown mapping
agent_execution_scope: Prove device association and normalize telemetry
Report issues without changing state or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A Redfish sensor read is relevant but insecure and materially incomplete without IPMI, ROCm, Web and device-index proof.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Map physical OAM_3 to each interface, capture synchronized Redfish/IPMI/ROCm/Web sensor data securely, and compare the complete normalized set.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All three source tools, Web parity, OAM_3 and 5/5-minute timing remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prepend every sensor table with stable OAM identity and ROCm BDF/UUID mapping, then retain raw/time/unit/status before normalized comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents an apparently valid ROCm GPU index from being compared to the wrong physical module.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No neighboring OAM or generic GPU aggregate satisfies OAM_3.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: ROCm logical numbering may change after reboot; the mapping must be captured in the same run.

project_override_considerations: Engineering defines the authoritative association among OAM_3 service label, Redfish member, IPMI labels and ROCm BDF/UUID.
expected_evidence: Logs, discrepancies, cleanup and owner verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source intent and criteria are coherent; DeepSeek is an incomplete unsafe implementation, not conflicting source authority.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The needed mapping and tooling are project prerequisites that can be supplied.

review_improvement: Makes OAM_3 physical attribution explicit so a valid sample from the wrong ROCm device cannot create false parity.
independent_technical_reasoning: ROCm device indices are enumeration artifacts and can change after firmware, driver or boot-order changes. A comparison keyed only by `card3` or index 3 may silently use another OAM while Redfish still targets OAM_3. Stable BDF/UUID and service-label association must be captured in the same run before any numeric sensor delta has meaning.
